entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Envelope containing twelve planes, separating them from the rest of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Blast whose side-effect formed the Shard.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: Arrived in Dominaria before the Shard formed.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose home plane was in the Shard.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Described the Shard as a darkness keeping him from his plane.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Described the Shard as a knife cutting off their portals.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane drifting through the Shard's boundary.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Escaped the Shard by planeswalking to Shandalar.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Used Shandalar's passing to fuel the World Spell.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell that broke the Shard and ended the Ice Age.

events.summary: The Shard forms as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast, binding nearby planes and trapping many planeswalkers.
events.quote: The Shard was formed as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast

events.summary: Faralyn, Leshrac and Tevesh Szat escape by planeswalking to Shandalar.
Freyalise fuels the World Spell with Shandalar's passing, breaking the Shard and ending the Ice Age.
events.quote: which broke the Shard and ended the Ice Age

relations.quote: The Shard was formed as a side-effect of the Sylex Blast
